title: Jev zero-shot classifier lane
description:
Zero-shot classification with TypeSafe Jev, per sentence, paragraph and document.

## Scope
- Async client on `typesafe-sdk` (`AsyncTypeSafeClient`, `RetryPolicy`), modelled on `Jev-Flywheel/jev_flywheel/jev.py`: one request per segment with all applicable questions, in-flight de-duplication, bounded concurrency, usage/cost accounting. Env: `TYPESAFE_API_KEY`, optional `TYPESAFE_BASE_URL` (allows Laya fallback).
- Compile classifier detectors → questions (`noul`/`choice`/`score`, instructions, criteria); policy examples go into `state` as labeled examples.
- Sentence state `{target, paragraph}`.
- Cache keyed by question-set fingerprint + segment hash; no raw text stored in cache artifacts.
- Thresholds and `reviewBand` per detector; mark mid-band results `status: review`.
- Fake resolver for tests; no network in CI.

## Notes
- Raw Jev probabilities are overconfident; `confidence` is peakedness, not P(correct). Watch first-option position bias in `choice` criteria ordering.
- Rough cost: ~150k input tokens per 40-paragraph article (~$0.01).

## Done when
- `check()` returns classifier findings + coverage for a fixture pack; incremental rescan only re-queries changed segments.
